text: R1 TSK: every TSK entry printed for 1 Cor 11:3, 4, …, 16, all of it, verbatim, in source order.
R2 cites-passage: every Nave's / Torrey's topic with a line citing any verse of 1 Cor 11:3–16. linked_verses = the cited verses.
R3 see-chain: topics named by a "See X" line inside an R2 topic (one level only).

R4 keyword: topics whose SUBJECT (title) contains any of these keywords (case-insensitive, whole word or prefix as listed): hair, head, veil, covering, turban, mitre, miter, bonnet, crown, shav*, shorn, bald*, beard, nazarite, nazirite, vow, captive, leprosy, cleans*, purif*, mourning, woman, women, man, angel*, glory, nature, custom, prophe*, prayer, worship, authority, image, creation. Every keyword also matches its plural (vow → vows, nazarite → nazarites) — added 2026-10-18 by the orchestrator. linked_verses = in-scope verses whose BSB or KJV text contains the keyword stem (if none, [], shown under "Whole passage").
R5 user: passages supplied by the study author (file data/user_xrefs.json, orchestrator-owned).
R6 commentator-cited: built at integration from scripture_refs_cited of commentary rows.
